description: Urgent trunk fix fastlane for shikanime repos: direct commit on main when unprotected, else a fast-tracked PR that skips the issue ledger.

cases.name: positive-hotfix-main
cases.prompt: Hotfix main — there's a broken config on the trunk, patch it now and don't bother with an issue.
assertions: body references sks-commit for commit shape
body detects protection via rulesets not classic branch protection
body offers a direct-commit path and a fast-tracked-PR path

cases.name: positive-urgent-trunk
cases.prompt: urgent trunk fix needed, push the patch straight to main
assertions: body says verify landing against real output

cases.name: negative-normal-feature
cases.prompt: Add a new feature branch and open a PR with a full issue ledger for review.
assertions: body scope states a hotfix is one defect, not unrelated refactors
skill does not claim to replace the full issue lifecycle for normal work

cases.name: negative-cpn
cases.prompt: Ouvre une issue en français dans cloud-pi-native et prépare la PR.
assertions: skill is in the shikanime family with an sks- prefix, no cpn- cross-leak
